position.target: Distinguish pre-study odds R from probability
position.location: PDF page 1, Modeling the Framework for False Positive Findings

explained: R is true relationships divided by absent relationships; pre-study probability is R/(R+1).
PPV conditions on a claimed statistically significant finding.
